text.p: Swing-N-Slide Corp, which makes wooden playground equipment, said Friday it plans to conduct a $2.5 million rights offering for shareholders other than its majority stockholder, GreenGrass Holdings.
Swing-N-Slide said it will offer stockholders the right to purchase their pro rata number of shares aggregating $2.5 million.

Earlier, Swing-N-Slide raised $5.0 million by selling GreenGrass 1,087,406 shares of Swing-N-Slide common at $4.5981 per share. This was related to its purchase of GameTime Inc in a deal valued at $40.4 million.

Swing-N-Slide said it also replaced its senior debt with a $69.5 million senior secured facility. It raised an additional $12.5 million from Massachusetts Mutual Life Insurance Co and its affiliates. MassMutual purchased 12 percent senior subordinated notes due March 13, 2005, and warrants to purchase 592,177 shares of Swing-N-Slide common.
Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp acted as agent for Swing-N-Slide in connection with these financings.
